# has privacy notice

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasPrivacyNotice`](gmeow-hasPrivacyNotice.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPrivacyNotice>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an entity or rights statement to its privacy notice. Domain-free: a notice may be attached to a [`RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md), a Licence, or directly to the governed entity.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:PrivacyNotice`](../classes/gmeow-PrivacyNotice.md)

Use [`gmeow:hasPrivacyNotice`](gmeow-hasPrivacyNotice.md) from `?` to [`gmeow:PrivacyNotice`](../classes/gmeow-PrivacyNotice.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a [`gmeow:PrivacyNotice`](../classes/gmeow-PrivacyNotice.md) to whatever it documents — a governed entity, a [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md), or a [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md); domain-free so any of them may bear it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it to carry the consent rules themselves (those are [`gmeow:Permission`](../classes/gmeow-Permission.md) / [`gmeow:Prohibition`](../classes/gmeow-Prohibition.md) / [`gmeow:Duty`](../classes/gmeow-Duty.md) on a [`RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md)) and avoid pointing it at anything but a [`gmeow:PrivacyNotice`](../classes/gmeow-PrivacyNotice.md).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:hasPrivacyNotice`](gmeow-hasPrivacyNotice.md) from the entity or rights statement to its [`gmeow:PrivacyNotice`](../classes/gmeow-PrivacyNotice.md); keep the regulated processing on the statement's rules.

### Examples

- ex:acmeCorp [`gmeow:hasPrivacyNotice`](gmeow-hasPrivacyNotice.md) ex:notice.
